en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear, sounds like a modern or semi-composed song but I cannot name an author. 'пасој да менвиш' is my reading (something like 'change the burial cloth/passport?'); 'посврши' is my reading of 'married off'. Several dialect forms (најдвевме, кажвавме).

lines.en: while he was not yet married,

lines.cyr: с' него живеав, на него мислев,
lines.lat: s' nego živeav, na nego mislev,
lines.en: I lived with him, thought of him,
for him I gave my life.

lines.cyr: Проклета да е мајка ти, лудо,
lines.lat: Prokleta da e majka ti, ludo,

lines.cyr: што те посврши за друго либе!
lines.lat: što te posvrši za drugo libe!
lines.en: who married you off to another love!

lines.cyr: Јас да те љубам, да полудевам,
lines.lat: Jas da te ljubam, da poludevam,
lines.en: I love you, I go mad,

lines.cyr: кој сум - што сум, да не знам каде сум.
lines.lat: koj sum - što sum, da ne znam kade sum.
lines.en: who I am, what I am, I do not know where I am.

lines.cyr: и со време да је паметиш,
lines.lat: i so vreme da je pametiš,
lines.en: and may you remember it in time,

lines.cyr: кај се најдвевме и си кажвавме
lines.lat: kaj se najdvevme i si kažvavme
lines.en: where we met and told each other

lines.cyr: од срце болки што си имавме.
lines.lat: od srce bolki što si imavme.
lines.en: the pains of the heart that we had.

lines.cyr: ко ќе умрам ти да ми дојдиш
lines.lat: ko ḱe umram ti da mi dojdiš
lines.en: when I die, you come to me,

lines.cyr: солзи да рониш, пасој да менвиш
lines.lat: solzi da roniš, pasoj da menviš
lines.en: shed tears, change the grave cloth(?),
for the love that we had.
